component.name: Zyntrix Compatibility Fabric
component.summary: Universal application compatibility platform and runtime orchestrator

description.p: The Zyntrix Compatibility Fabric (ZCF) is an open-source, distribution-independent application compatibility platform that coordinates existing compatibility engines (Wine, Proton, QEMU, Box64, Waydroid), investigates software behavior, diagnoses incompatibilities, and applies reproducible fixes throughout the Linux ecosystem.

ul.li: Transparent binfmt_misc and desktop launcher integration for Windows and foreign architecture binaries
Deterministic, explainable runtime recommendation and constraint planner
Automated failure diagnosis with distribution-tailored remediation commands
Bubblewrap (bwrap) security sandboxing and isolated runtime prefix management
Autonomous reverse-engineering workflows backed by REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)
Headless virtual display (Xvfb) lifecycle automation for servers, containers, and CI

description.p: Production release featuring execution orchestration, binfmt_misc kernel integration, multi-architecture inspection, and automated remediation synthesis.
